item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Nothing to do with…,” Mike Hesson breaks silence on his tense exchange with Salman Ali Agha
item.description: Some heated scenes were witnessed in the Pakistan dugout when the Men in Green faced Namibia in a must-win T20 World Cup 2026 Group A clash at SSC, Colombo on Wednesday (February 18). Opting to bat first, Pakistan lost Saim Ayub cheaply but Sahibzada Farhan and skipper Salman Ali Agha added 67 runs for the second wicket to steady the ship. item.title: “I worry for people who are worried about Abhishek's form”: Suryakumar Yadav ahead of India’s T20 World Cup Super 8s

item.title: “It would be a shame…”: Harry Brook reacts as Pakistan cricketers face snub threat from Indian-owned The Hundred franchises
item.description: It would be "a shame" if Pakistan cricketers are left out of The Hundred, England's white-ball skipper Harry Brook said on Saturday (February 21). Rumours are rife that Indian-owned Hundred franchises - Manchester Super Giants, MI London, Southern Brave, and Sunrisers Leeds - may not sign Pakistani players at the auction amid concerns over potential political backlash in India due to ongoing tensions between two nations. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “I would love to see one of the lesser teams,” Rahul Dravid hopes for India versus Zimbabwe final
item.description: Team India entered the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 with a lot of expectations, and certainly lived up to the hype at the end of the group-stage. The Suryakumar Yadav-led side won all four of their group matches, and will enter the next phase of the tournament as firm favorites. India will face South Africa (February 22 in Ahmedabad), Zimbabwe (February 26 in Chennai) and West Indies (March 1 in Kolkata) in the Super 8s. item.title: WATCH: “You mean, I should make him play for Tilak?” Suryakumar Yadav laughs off idea of including Sanju Samson in playing XI
item.description: On the eve of India’s Super 8 opener against South Africa, skipper Suryakumar Yadav dismissed suggestions about replacing Tilak Varma with Sanju Samson in the team lineup. Although the defending champions won all four of their Group A matches, Tilak’s struggle against spinners on slow wickets didn’t go unnoticed. item.description: India opener Abhishek Sharma, who was expected to set the T20 World Cup 2026 on fire, recorded three consecutive ducks in the group stage of the tournament. item.title: “Kya free ke paise le rahe hain?”: Kaif questions Mike Hesson’s tactics; advices Pakistan to hire coach from India
item.description: Pakistan may have qualified for the T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8s, but head coach Mike Hesson’s tactics were questioned during their 61-run defeat to India in the group stage.
